title: Decoder-Preserving Sparse Autoencoders: Which Readouts Survive Sparse Compression?
abstract: arXiv:2607.17425v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) compress model activations into sparse codes, but equal reconstruction error and sparsity can preserve different linearly decodable signals. We formalize this ambiguity as a matrix-valued distortion between optimal ridge-prediction operators and train decoder-preserving SAEs by combining this distortion with reconstruction loss. In a rank relaxation, an isotropic task prior saturates per-mode omission costs without changing PCA's ordering, whereas a structured prior can change which modes are retained. A controlled sparse experiment shows that a declared prior protects held-out combinations from its task subspace. On GPT-2 small block 8, DPSAE reduces held-out decoder distortion by 10.6--11.4% across three paired runs while matching reconstruction NMSE. translated_title: 保留解码器的稀疏自编码器：哪些读出信号能在稀疏压缩中幸存？
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）将模型激活压缩为稀疏编码，但即使重构误差和稀疏度相同，所保留的线性可解码信号也可能不同。我们将这种模糊性形式化为最优岭回归预测算子之间的矩阵值失真，并通过将此失真与重构损失相结合来训练保留解码器的稀疏自编码器。在秩松弛框架下，各向同性任务先验在不改变PCA排序的情况下使每个模式的省略成本饱和，而结构化先验则可以改变哪些模式被保留。一项受控稀疏实验表明，声明的先验能够保护来自其任务子空间的留出组合。在GPT-2 small第8块上，DPSAE在三次配对运行中将留出解码器失真降低了10.6–11.4%，同时保持相当的归一化均方重构误差（NMSE）。相同的检查点通过了平均自然文本输出KL散度非劣性测试，但一对匹配的Pythia模型在仅限于特定子空间的探针上未显示出改进（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出保留解码器稀疏自编码器（DPSAE），将最优岭回归预测算子间的矩阵值失真与重构损失共同纳入训练目标，从而在稀疏压缩中更好地保留线性可解码的任务信号，在GPT-2上使留出解码器失真降低10.6–11.4%的同时保持重构质量与输出分布。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Decoder-Preserving Sparse Autoencoders (DPSAE), which combine reconstruction loss with a matrix-valued distortion between optimal ridge-prediction operators to preserve linearly decodable signals during sparse compression, reducing held-out decoder distortion by 10.6–11.4% on GPT-2 small while matching reconstruction NMSE.
